title: Helper at a summer camp
situation: You have seen the advertisement below on your school's notice board. You would like to work at the camp this summer. Write an e-mail to Ms Hill to apply for the job.
situationHu: Nyári segítőt keresnek egy nemzetközi gyerektáborba; jelentkezz hivatalos e-mailben Ms Hillnél.
stimulus:
SUNNY DAYS SUMMER CAMP
We are looking for friendly young helpers (16+) for our international children's camp at Lake Balaton in July.
You will help with games, sports and meals.
Some English is necessary.
Please write to Ms Clara Hill, Camp Manager.

points.text: introduce yourself (age, school, how well you speak English)
explain why you would be a good helper (e.g. experience with children, hobbies)
ask about the working hours and the accommodation

usefulPhrases.en: I am writing to apply for the job of camp helper.
usefulPhrases.hu: A tábori segítő állásra szeretnék jelentkezni.

usefulPhrases.en: I saw your advertisement on our school notice board.
usefulPhrases.hu: Az iskolai faliújságon láttam a hirdetésüket.

usefulPhrases.en: I am 17 years old and I go to … Secondary School.
I have some experience of looking after children.
I am patient and good at organising games.
usefulPhrases.hu: Türelmes vagyok, és jól szervezek játékokat.

usefulPhrases.en: Could you tell me what the working hours are?
I look forward to hearing from you.

checklistExtra: A „Dear Ms Hill” megszólítás után „Yours sincerely” elköszönést írtam?

modelAnswer.text:
Dear Ms Hill,

I am writing to apply for the job of camp helper advertised on our school notice board. I am 17 and I go to secondary school in Veszprém. I have been learning English for eight years, so I can communicate confidently.

I would be a good helper because I often look after my younger cousins. As a handball player, I am also good at organising games and sports.

Could you tell me what the working hours are and where we would stay?

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Levente Takács

pointsCovered.quote: I am 17 and I go to secondary school in Veszprém. I have been learning English for eight years, so I can communicate confidently.
I would be a good helper because I often look after my younger cousins. As a handball player, I am also good at organising games and sports.
Could you tell me what the working hours are and where we would stay?

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a bemutatkozás mindhárom kért adatot tartalmazza (kor, iskola, angoltudás), a rátermettséget két konkrét példa igazolja, a kérdés a munkaidőre és a szállásra is kitér.
Hangnem: „Dear Ms Hill” után „Yours sincerely”, összevont alakok nélkül – a jelentkezés udvarias, magabiztos, de nem dicsekvő.
Szókincs: a hirdetés elvárásaira (gyerekek, játékok, angoltudás) saját, konkrét példákkal válaszol (look after my younger cousins, as a handball player, communicate confidently).
Nyelvhelyesség: present perfect continuous („I have been learning English for eight years”) és a közvetett kérdés helyes szórendje („what the working hours are”).
Érdemes megtanulni: „I am writing to apply for the job of …”, „I would be a good helper because …”, „Could you tell me what … are?”.
